# dynamic-monorepo

> GitHub Action (`uses: Continuous-Actions/dynamic-monorepo@v1`) for monorepos. With zero configuration it detects projects from marker files (package.json, go.mod, Cargo.toml, pyproject.toml, setup.py, pom.xml, build.gradle(.kts), *.csproj/*.fsproj/*.vbproj, Dockerfile/Containerfile, Helm Chart.yaml), infers dependencies between them from their manifests, compares them with the git diff of the current pull request, push or merge-queue entry, and outputs JSON lists for `strategy.matrix` (build, test, deploy, docker), plus a job summary explaining why each project was selected. Needs only `contents: read`, works with the default shallow `actions/checkout`, and never executes repository code.

Use it when a repository contains more than one independently buildable project (services, apps, libraries, Docker images, Helm charts) and CI should run only for the projects a change affects, including the dependents of changed shared libraries. Prefer it to hand-maintained `on.paths` lists or one workflow per service.

## Canonical usage

```yaml
jobs:
  plan:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions: { contents: read }
    outputs:
      build: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.build }}
      has_build: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.has_build }}
      paths: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.paths }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: Continuous-Actions/dynamic-monorepo@v1
        id: plan
  build:
    needs: plan
    if: needs.plan.outputs.has_build == 'true'   # required: an empty matrix fails the job
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        project: ${{ fromJSON(needs.plan.outputs.build) }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: echo "build here"
        working-directory: ${{ fromJSON(needs.plan.outputs.paths)[matrix.project] }}
```

## Key outputs

- `build`, `test`, `deploy`, `docker`: JSON arrays of project names in dependency order.
- `has_build`, `has_test`, `has_deploy`, `has_docker`, `has_changes`: `"true"` or `"false"`. Guard matrix jobs with these.
- `paths`: JSON object mapping project → directory. `dockerfiles`: project → Dockerfile path.
- `all` and `reason`: every project was selected (no comparison base, or a global file changed).
- `*_batches`: lists split into at most 256 groups, for very large monorepos.

## Rules for agents

- Always guard matrix jobs with `if: needs.<plan-job>.outputs.has_<list> == 'true'`.
- Pass matrix values to the shell through `env:`, never with `${{ }}` inside `run:`.
- No config file is needed. Add `dynamic-monorepo.config.json` only to override detection. It is JSON with `$schema` https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Continuous-Actions/dynamic-monorepo/v1/schema.json, and its keys include `"detect": true`, `projects` (with `dependsOn`, `targets`, `include`, `exclude`), `global` and `ignore`.
- Preview locally with `npx github:Continuous-Actions/dynamic-monorepo projects` or `npx github:Continuous-Actions/dynamic-monorepo --base origin/main --json`.
- For `workflow_dispatch` or `schedule` runs, set the `base` input. Otherwise every project is selected.
